summary: -i is parsed into iterations, and its timed region contains one persistent OpenMP team with a static row loop nested inside the iteration loop. The scheduled row domain is the complete [0, numRows), and each row traverses its CSR entries and stores h_out[i]. The outlined worker assembly retains an iteration-count back edge enclosing row/CSR work, with actual loads, multiply/adds, and stores. No omitted or hoisted timed iterations identified.

source_evidence.claim: The -i option populates iterations. The timed region runs iter<iterations, then a static OpenMP for over all rows 0..numRows-1; each row traverses h_rowDelimiters and accumulates h_val[j]*h_vec[h_cols[j]] into h_out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: The outlined worker establishes its static partition, then enters the outer iteration loop. Its row body reads row delimiters, columns, values, and vector entries, multiplies and accumulates, and stores output; after row completion it increments the iteration counter and branches back until the requested count.
